name: Sherborne Investors (Guernsey) B Limited
summary: Sherborne Investors (Guernsey) B Limited functions as a private equity firm, dedicating its capital to undervalued enterprises and those undergoing significant restructuring. Its investment strategy is sector-agnostic, exploring prospects across any industry. The firm predominantly seeks out publicly traded companies, typically listed on UK stock exchanges, and commits to holding these positions for more than a year. A core tenet of its approach is to concentrate its resources on a single target company at any given time. It specifically identifies publicly quoted businesses, often UK-listed, that it deems undervalued due to operational shortcomings. The firm's conviction is that proactive engagement from its Investment Manager can rectify these deficiencies, thereby significantly enhancing the investment's value. Incorporated on November 8, 2012, Sherborne Investors (Guernsey) B Limited is headquartered in St Peter Port, Channel Islands.
